title: 第18章 判若两人第19章 时光如梭
slug: 剑里乾坤第3107章不似作伪
content_zh:
一老一少就这样坐在床上，一个运功调息恢复自己刚刚消耗的内力，一个在那里尝试掌握自己刚刚获得的内力，一个补充内力，一个掌控内力！房间里面这时除了他俩的呼吸，没有任何其他声音，这时包围着老庄的雾团越来越薄，越来越少，直到完全消失，老庄这才从床上下来，看着还在打坐的卓然，脸上落出满意的笑容！
只有他知道，他为了弄到这粒丹药，老脸都不要了，第一次求着多少年的老朋友“见死不救”白费心，软磨硬泡好几天，最后又答应白费新一个条件，才弄到这粒丹丸的！原来十年前白费新采药的时候，在长白山无意中得到一株千年“血龙参”，这是一颗长的犹如龙型的千年红色野参，这颗血龙参由于是及热之物，所以要配合百年天山雪莲的果实，利用雪莲果的寒性，一起炼化融合，互相克制才能吞服，在辅以其它天材地宝，奇花异草！白费新为了收集这些药材，遍寻各大山川，费时五年终于集齐所有药材，又经过七七四十九天炼制，一共才得到三粒丹丸！白费新给这丹丸起名叫“洗筋增元丹”！这粒丹药的功效，是把二十岁身体还没定型的，年轻人经脉变强变粗，同时可以凭空增加二十年内力！由于功效太强，丹药炼成以后，白费新只告诉了老朋友老庄一个人，由于白费新和老庄当年的年龄不适合服用，所以一直保存至今，后来有一次白费新在深山里面采药，不慎从山崖落下来，身受重伤，就在生死一线的时候，被当地一位猎户救了下来，白费新为了报答猎户的救命之恩，送了一粒“洗经增元丹”给猎户，白费新治病救人，炼丹之术可以说天下无双，但是武功却是很稀松平常要不也不会从悬崖上掉下来！后来猎户妻子病重，把这粒丹药拿到市场上去卖，这粒丹药当年还在江湖上掀起腥风血雨！为了这粒丹药，武林各大势力为了培养自己的后辈，明争暗斗，死伤无数，最后这粒丹药落到谁手里，已经成了一个谜！可以说这粒丹丸是万金难求的宝贝！老庄找到白费新以后也是软磨硬泡四五天，最后白费新提出一个条件“就是老庄以后帮他做一件事！”这才得到这粒丹药的！
这时外面也响起开门的声音，高碧柔回来做饭了，老庄打开房门，走出来对高碧柔说道“夫人！卓然已经吞服了丹丸，正在房间里面调息，效果很好，夫人请放心！”高碧柔闻言，悬着的一颗心才放了下来！高碧柔连忙说道“庄老！卓然这孩子让您费心了！遇到您也是然儿的造化！”老庄呵呵一笑说道“这孩子和我有缘！”就在这时卓然从房间里面跑出来，他大声的对老高喊道“师父，我感觉已经能够掌控那些力量了，感觉现在精力比以前充沛多了！”高碧柔看着这一老一小，笑了一下就走进厨房了。卓然则是兴奋异常，拉着老庄不停的问这问那的，老庄都笑着一一回答了卓然的问题。然后他指着院子外面一块大约有二百斤左右的石头说道“然儿！那块石头你搬一下看看”其实老庄知道，以前卓然肯定是搬不动的，但是现在他突然增加了二十年的内力，搬起这块石头一点问题都没有，甚至更大一点的，卓然也能搬起来，他这样做的目的就是想看看，卓然能不能掌控自己体内的内力而已！卓然看看那块石头摇了摇头说道“师父！这块石头太大了，然儿搬不动！”老庄呵呵一笑说道“然儿！你现在要学会利用你丹田里面那团气，你把那团气运行到双手试着搬一下看看！”卓然闻言走到那块石头面前，扎好马步，把内力运行到手上，双手一用力他就把那块石头高高的举过头顶。
而这一幕恰巧被在水井旁边洗菜的高碧柔看见了！她惊的直接把菜都掉到了地上，双手捂着嘴，眼睛睁的溜圆，她都不敢相信，一个年仅七岁的小男孩，把一块二百斤的石头举过头顶！她连忙用手掐了一下自己的胳膊，一股疼痛感袭来！她知道这不是幻觉，这是真实发生的事情！而这男孩就是自己的儿子！她连忙跑到老庄前面，她结结巴巴的说道“庄老！这！这是真的吗？”她现在只想再次证实一下！老庄笑着点头说道“和你看见的一样！”说完以后他又对卓然说道“然儿！快把石头放下来，要是让别人看见了，还不把人吓出毛病呀！”卓然闻言把石头轻轻的放到原来那位置，他很骄傲的对高碧柔说道“娘！然儿现在可厉害了！您看见了吧？”高碧柔这时转身扑通一声给老庄跪了下来，老庄却是被她这举动吓了一跳，又不好伸手去扶，连忙说道“夫人！你这是干什么呀？你快起来呀！让别人看见这成什么了呀？”高碧柔恭恭敬敬的给老庄磕了三个头，然后她站起来说道“庄老！卓然遇到您是他的幸运，您为了培养卓然所做的一切，我实在不知道怎么报答您！我只能给您老磕三个头！表达一下对您的感激之情！”老庄手摸了一下自己的白胡子呵呵一笑说道“我们先到院子里面再说吧！”
三人来到院子里面，小卓然这时很是兴奋，一会搬搬水缸，一会把高碧柔抱起来，老庄干咳了一声说道“然儿！今天上午马步还没扎了吧！记住不管在什么时候，下盘一定要稳，从今天晚上开始不要再打坐了，调息的时候也扎马步！”卓然闻言连忙扎起马步。高碧柔一边笑着一边把刚刚掉落的菜拣起来，满脸欣慰的看了一下卓然走进了厨房！老庄看着卓然说道“然儿！以后不许在外人面前展露你的内力！听见了没？”卓然闻言连忙点头答应。老庄这才满意的泡了一杯茶，坐下来休闲的喝着茶，心里也是美滋滋的！
content_en:
An old man and a young man were sitting on the bed like this, one was doing exercises and regulating his breath to restore the internal power he had just consumed, the other was trying to master the internal power he had just gained, one was replenishing the internal power, and the other was controlling the internal power! There was no other sound in the room except their breathing. At this time, the fog surrounding Lao Zhuang became thinner and thinner, until it completely disappeared. Only then did Lao Zhuang get off the bed and look at Zhuo Ran, who was still meditating, with a satisfied smile on his face!
Only he knows that in order to get this pill, he gave up his old face. He begged his old friend for the first time to "do nothing to save him" in vain, worked hard for several days, and finally agreed to a new condition in vain to get this pill! It turns out that ten years ago when I was collecting new herbs in vain, I accidentally got a thousand-year-old "blood dragon ginseng" in Changbai Mountain. This is a thousand-year-old red wild ginseng that is like a dragon. Since this blood dragon ginseng is a hot thing, it needs to be combined with the fruit of the century-old Tianshan snow lotus, using the cold nature of the snow lotus fruit, to refine and fuse together, and restrain each other before swallowing it. It is supplemented by other natural materials, rare flowers and rare herbs! In order to collect these medicinal materials, Bai Feixin searched all over the mountains and rivers. It took him five years to finally collect all the medicinal materials, and after seven, seven and forty-nine days of refining, he got a total of three pills! In vain, Fei Xin named this pill "Wash the Tendons and Increase the Yuan Pill"! The effect of this elixir is to make the meridians of a twenty-year-old body that has not yet been finalized become stronger and thicker, and at the same time, it can increase the internal energy of twenty years out of thin air! Because the effect of the elixir was too strong, Bai Feixin only told his old friend Lao Zhuang after the elixir was made. Since Bai Feixin and Lao Zhuang were not suitable for taking it at that age, they have kept it until now. Later, Bai Feixin was collecting herbs in the mountains and accidentally fell from the cliff and was seriously injured. When he was on the front line, he was saved by a local hunter. In order to repay Orion for saving his life, Bai Feixin gave him a "Sutra Cleansing and Enhancing Pill". Bai Feixin treated illnesses and saved people. His alchemy skills can be said to be unparalleled in the world, but his martial arts are very ordinary, otherwise he would not fall off the cliff! Later, Orion's wife became seriously ill and took this elixir to the market to sell. This elixir still caused a bloody storm in the world! For this pill, the major forces in the martial arts fought openly and covertly to train their descendants, resulting in countless deaths and injuries. In the end, whose hands this pill fell into has become a mystery! It can be said that this pill is a treasure that is hard to find! After Lao Zhuang found Bai Feixin, he worked hard for four or five days. Finally, Bai Feixin made a condition: "Lao Zhuang will do something for him in the future!" Only then did he get this pill!
At this time, there was a sound of opening the door outside. Gao Birou came back to cook. Lao Zhuang opened the door, walked out and said to Gao Birou, "Madam! Zhuo Ran has swallowed the pills and is adjusting his breath in the room. The effect is very good. Madam, please don't worry!" After hearing this, Gao Birou felt relieved! Gao Birou hurriedly said, "Mr. Zhuang! Zhuoran, this kid has troubled you! Meeting you is Ran'er's fate!" Lao Zhuang laughed and said, "This kid is destined for me!" At this moment, Zhuo Ran ran out of the room. He shouted loudly to Lao Gao, "Master, I feel that I can control those powers. I feel that I have more energy now than before!" Gao Birou looked at the old and the young, smiled and walked into the kitchen. Zhuo Ran was extremely excited and pulled Lao Zhuang to ask questions. Lao Zhuang answered Zhuo Ran's questions one by one with a smile. Then he pointed to a stone outside the yard that weighed about 200 kilograms and said, "Of course! Move that stone and have a look." In fact, Lao Zhuang knew that Zhuoran must not have been able to move it before, but now that he has suddenly increased his internal strength for twenty years, he has no problem at all in lifting this stone. Even larger ones, Zhuoran can also lift. His purpose of doing this is just to see if Zhuoran can control the internal force in his body!Zhuoran looked at the stone and shook his head and said, "Master! This stone is too big, Ran'er can't move it!" Lao Zhuang chuckled and said, "Ran'er! Now you have to learn to use the Qi in your Dantian. Move the Qi to your hands and try to move it!" Zhuo Ran heard this and walked to the stone, braced himself, and transferred his internal energy to his hands. He raised the stone high above his head with a strong effort of his hands.
And this scene happened to be seen by Gao Birou, who was washing vegetables next to the well! She was so shocked that she dropped the dishes to the ground, covered her mouth with both hands, and opened her eyes wide. She couldn't believe that a little boy of only seven years old lifted a two hundred kilogram stone above his head! She quickly pinched her arm with her hand, feeling a pain coming over her! She knew this wasn't a hallucination, this was really happening! And this boy is his son! She quickly ran to Lao Zhuang and stammered, "Mr. Zhuang! This! Is this true?" She just wanted to confirm it again! Lao Zhuang smiled and nodded and said, "It's the same as what you saw!" After that, he said to Zhuoran, "Ran'er! Put the stone down quickly. If others see it, it won't scare them out of trouble!" Zhuo Ran heard this and gently put the stone where it was. Position, he proudly said to Gao Birou, "Mom! Ran'er is so powerful now! Have you seen it?" Gao Birou turned around and knelt down to Lao Zhuang with a plop. Lao Zhuang was shocked by her move and couldn't reach out to help him, so he hurriedly said "Madam! What are you doing? Get up! Let others see what is happening?" Gao Birou kowtowed three times to Lao Zhuang respectfully, then she stood up and said, "Old Zhuang! Zhuoran is lucky to meet you. You want to cultivate him Zhuoran, I really don’t know how to repay you! I can only kowtow to you three times to express my gratitude!" Lao Zhuang touched his white beard and said with a smile, "Let’s talk in the yard first!"
The three of them came to the yard. Little Zhuoran was very excited at this time. He moved the water tank and picked up Gao Birou. Lao Zhuang coughed and said, "Ran'er! You haven't stepped into the horse stance this morning! Remember, no matter what time, the lower body must be stable. From tonight on, don't meditate anymore, and do the horse stance when adjusting your breath!" Hearing this, Zhuoran quickly stepped into the horse stance. Gao Birou picked up the dishes that had just been dropped while smiling, and looked at Zhuoran with a pleased face as he walked into the kitchen! Lao Zhuang looked at Zhuoran and said, "Ran'er! Don't show your inner strength in front of outsiders in the future! Do you hear that?" Zhuoran nodded in agreement after hearing this. Only then did Lao Zhuang make a cup of tea with satisfaction. He sat down and drank the tea leisurely, feeling very happy in his heart!
